summary: Tiny, steep 11 m kerb at a bend, right beside a house and driveways.
reasons: House and driveways directly behind kerb

drivers.seclusion: A house with solar panels sits about 10 m behind the kerb (unmapped in OSM) and a driveway enters at the start; mapped home 40 m away.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed road reaches it, but 11 m of kerb is barely a van length and driveways cut into it.
drivers.traffic: Quiet street near a junction at a bend.
drivers.convention: One car parked at a driveway; no parking convention.

flags: Unmapped house very close on own side
sun_shade: Dense tree canopy from the north and east shades most of it.

best_section.where: South kerb at the Jenkinson Street bend next to the side street junction
